title: Easy Tofu Stir-Fry
subtitle: with Sweet Soy and Cashews
description: Looking for dinner on the table quick smart? These fast recipes are ready in 25 minutes or less and all come with yumness guaranteed.

steps.text: Cook rice: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Put in a small saucepan with 250ml (1 cup) water, cover and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 12 mins or until tender and the water is absorbed. Turn off the heat and stand, covered, for at least 5 mins. Fluff the rice with a fork.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, halve the carrot lengthwise and thinly slice on an angle. Halve the zucchini lengthwise and thinly slice on an angle. Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove. Quarter the tofu pieces. Combine the kecap manis, 1 tbs soy sauce, 1 tsp sugar and 2 tbs water in a bowl.

Stir-fry tofu: Put the tofu in a large bowl, scatter with 2 tsp plain flour and toss to coat. Heat 1 tbs vegetable oil in a large deep frypan over medium-high heat (see Kitchen 101). Stir-fry the tofu for 2-3 mins until browned. Remove from the pan.

Stir-fry veggies: Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in the same frypan over high heat. Stir-fry the carrot for 1 min or until just starting to soften. Add the zucchini and garlic and stir-fry for 2-3 mins until the veggies are tender but still with crunch.

Serve up: Add the kecap manis mixture, cashews and tofu to the veggies and stir-fry for 1-2 mins until the sauce is slightly thickened and the tofu is warmed through. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with pepper. Divide the rice and tofu stir-fry among bowls and enjoy!

Kitchen 101: Fast and hot is key when stir-frying! Make sure you cook over a high heat, stirring constantly so everything is cooked evenly. We've used a deep frypan, but you can use a wok if you have one.
